organisation: Grid Controller of India (Grid-India; formerly POSOCO) - NLDC
title: Daily PSP (Power Supply Position) Report
url: https://grid-india.in/en/reports/daily-psp-report (file list via POST https://webapi.grid-india.in/api/v1/file {_source:GRDW;_type:DAILY_PSP_REPORT;_fileDate:<FY>;_month:00}; files at https://webcdn.grid-india.in/<FilePath>)
indicators: energy met; evening-peak demand met & shortage; max demand met of day & time; hydro/wind/solar gen; energy shortage; source-wise gross generation (coal, lignite, hydro, nuclear, gas, RES); RES & non-fossil share; solar/non-solar-hour peak; state max demand/energy met/shortage; 15-min all-India demand, solar, wind, hydro, thermal, gas, nuclear, storage
notes: Data date = 'Date of Reporting' minus 1 day. Earlier reports (pre-2023) are PDF only. Solar Gen footnote: RLDC data for ISTS solar + SLDC for embedded solar; limited visibility of embedded (rooftop) solar.

title: Monthly Operational Report September 2026
indicators: All-time-highest max demand met (solar / non-solar hours) and energy/hydro/wind/solar generation by region
notes: Listed on https://grid-india.in/en/reports/monthly-psp-report (FileType REPORTS_MONTHLY_REPORT; 180 monthly reports 2012-13 to 2026-27 available, not bulk-parsed)

organisation: Central Electricity Authority (CEA) - Renewable Energy Project Monitoring Division
title: Monthly Report of Renewable Generation (Monthly Renewable Energy Generation Report)
indicators: RE generation by source (wind, solar, biomass, bagasse, small hydro, others; large hydro added 2023-07) all-India and state-wise; current month, same month previous year, Apr-to-date
notes: State values marked * are provisional (carried from earlier report). Large hydro excludes imports from Bhutan.

title: Power Supply Position - Energy (monthly)
indicators: energy requirement, energy supplied/availability, energy not supplied (older reports: surplus/deficit(-)) by state/region/All India
notes: Some files also contain CEA gross-generation tables on other pages (not parsed).

title: Power Supply Position - Peak (monthly)
indicators: peak demand, peak met, demand not met (older: surplus/deficit) by state/region/All India

title: Load Generation Balance Report 2026-27
indicators: All-India energy requirement and peak demand trend; anticipated 2026-27 regional power supply position

title: National Electricity Plan (Vol I Generation) 2022-32 (Gazette 18.05.2023)
indicators: Energy requirement and peak demand projections per 20th Electric Power Survey (Table 4.2); likely source-wise gross generation 2026-27 and 2031-32 (Tables 5.11-5.12)
notes: The 20th EPS report itself was not found on the restructured CEA site; NEP reproduces its projections.

title: Monthly electricity data (global release)
indicators: generation by source, total generation, demand, net imports, shares
notes: Ember compiles from Grid-India/CEA and estimates; values as published.

title: Yearly electricity data (global release)
indicators: generation by source, total, demand, shares

title: India electricity data - monthly (states)
indicators: state-level generation by fuel and shares (also capacity & emissions in file)

title: India electricity data - yearly (states)
indicators: state-level generation by fuel and shares
